scope.production_deferred_effect_path: already collapsed multi-edit patches to one atomic write

symptom: Two text_replace operations targeting one file were sent to the editor sequentially. The first mutated the file, the second was rejected against the original hash, and the failed receipt reported rollback_attempted=false while the file remained partially changed.

dynamic_evidence.partial_effect: types.js changed to types.ts while simulation.js remained unchanged

root_cause.mechanism: written rollback state was appended only after every editor operation succeeded
root_cause.contract_mismatch: all operations carried the original file before_hash but were executed as independent mutations

behavior: Rebind each execution-only edit copy to the current physical file hash while preserving immutable plan and operation identities.
Register the patch rollback record immediately after the first accepted edit effect.
Detect mutation even when editor, writer, or deleter rejects or raises.
Register rollback before surfacing the failure and restore original UTF-8 content through the policy-gated writer.

lessons: Tool callbacks are untrusted effect ports; ok=true is insufficient without reading post-effect state.
Failure receipts must describe the physical state, including rollback attempts.
Multi-edit same-file plans require patch-level rollback plus per-effect current-hash binding, not repeated original-hash checks.
Repair resumes at the failed Director task and failed verifier; PM, CE, and green artifacts remain preserved.
